name: api-navigation-fit
goal: Every catalog category remains clickable beside Search and Settings at all compact widths after APIs extends the shared navigation.

steps.title: Identify the regression, prior working behavior, root cause, and evidence.
steps.evidence: The API insertion expands compact navigation from seven to eight links. The complete P4 Desktop browser run records Models clicks intercepted by the fixed Search icon at 768, 390 and 320 px. The prior CSS reserves the unused eighth grid cell only implicitly; all other existing width assertions are retained.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the regression; name the coverage gap and reusable test or shared guard change.
steps.evidence: The standard ui-search-fit matrix checked viewport/nav clipping and search versus revision fields, then timed out clicking Models. Extend its existing fits assertion to reject category/search bounding-box overlap at every declared width and search state. The stale seven-category matrices share an explicit test-owned ordered inventory; ordinary browser verification retains every interaction and overflow assertion.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: Record 07e6afb3b6b3336d3f5c5a4faddc0612f610b0862655d9217c367417898f2cc3 fails the unchanged category/search separation assertion at source 7793838ab4b13fc70fc706400fe6cd7f729860a0. Test-owned screenshots precede the checks. No timeout or broken fixture is used as product red proof.

steps.title: Propose a root-cause repair and an automated guard for the identified failure.
steps.evidence: Reserve the two existing 40px controls and their gaps outside wrapped tablet tabs, keeping the existing tab height and separate-row layout. On phones, append an empty grid cell so the final row always has room for Search and Settings. Strengthen the normal width matrix and retain all existing overflow, focus, navigation and revision assertions.

steps.title: Implement the repair and wire the prevention test or guard into normal project verification.
steps.evidence: Source f13d6d15e reserves the existing tablet controls before tab wrapping, keeps phone controls in the existing top row, and preserves the hosted account row focus clearance with the existing four-pixel token. The initial extra-phone-row proposal failed the unchanged 184px header bound and was replaced. The complete ordered inventory, existing bounds, overflow assertions and every width remain in normal Desktop and Hub verification.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: Final unchanged complete-corpus red 3c292efc52579ea59cbc9871e7b34ff4e3f3397a2e2b21f56b40c52fa78a6597 rejects the genuine hosted focus clearance at 9b6971bc8869e49b8e635e06da6a9a6b2df770d3. Green 8b861c9fac39c0195fad3211dfab9995a04fcd9c646c542fafe272bc0e3d5144 passes all 36 local and hosted cases at f13d6d15e. The full normal browser preflight also passes Desktop232 with one declared skip and Hub28.

steps.title: In an isolated fixture or temporary workspace, prove reintroducing the original failure makes the guard fail; restore and prove it passes.
steps.evidence: The original compact category/search overlap is retained in failing record 07e6afb3b6b3336d3f5c5a4faddc0612f610b0862655d9217c367417898f2cc3 with test-owned screenshots before assertions. The final complete-corpus historical hosted snapshot reintroduces the insufficient account gap and fails its existing focus assertion; restoring f13d6d15e passes the unchanged 36-case command. Fresh current 390px local Models, 768px local categories, and 390px hosted closed/open screenshots were copied and inspected. No header limit, focus clearance, timeout, game test or resource policy was relaxed.

steps.title: Repeat until the guard and relevant project checks pass; verify affected UI flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending while proof fails.
